spec_match.rationale: The decision switch consumes the real reliability read from a real session and covers exactly the three WebTransportReliabilityMode enum values plus an explicit unknown-value branch; requireUnreliable is presented as the spec's connect-time counterpart.

interactive.rationale: Construct-and-decide button with a requireUnreliable checkbox drives real constructions; live reads, connection outcome, matrix-row highlight, and a polite decision readout all update from real values.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a strategy table fed by a real session plus the requireUnreliable composition; the page has precisely those panels.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-WebTransport, attribute-missing, constructor-throw, and unknown-enum-value branches; copy explicitly separates the network-level refusal from a reliability rejection so the failure cannot be misread.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry, the reliability section, and the requireUnreliable option definition.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the feature-level 9-assertion suite including the enum-vocabulary assertion this page's switch mirrors; verified executing 1 pass / 7 fail / 1 blocked on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): ask clicked, checkbox toggled, ask clicked again on desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 — real WebTransportError outcomes rendered, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow, screenshots read. Partial: the live-highlight path (a row outlined from a real "pending" read) needs a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the live read stays within the enum on supporting builds and asserts the fallback branch explicitly; all session promises are claimed.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; checkbox uses accent-color from the palette; the live-row outline uses accent-emerald on bg-paper; buttons override background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Checkbox has a visible label wrapping it, buttons are native, the decision is one polite live region, the matrix is a captioned table with th scope, and the live row gains a text marker ("← this session, right now"), not a color-only cue.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: 0px horizontal overflow, wrapping controls row, 44px targets, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the row-highlight on a 158+ build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the strategy code can only run its feature-detect fallback. On a Chrome 158+ (or WebTransportReliability-flagged) build, confirm a construct against the dead endpoint highlights the "pending" row and the live reads show pending/false, then re-check the aria-live decision text matches the highlighted row.

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls checkbox labels touch targets keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible labels associated with controls (wrapping or for/id), minimum ~44px targets, native inputs over custom widgets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The requireUnreliable checkbox is a native input wrapped in its visible label with min-height 44px and a 1.4rem box; the primary action is a native button.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single polite region per surface; don't announce interstitial states; don't rely on color alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One aria-live output carries the decision; the highlighted matrix row adds a generated text suffix so the selection is not color-only; the only interstitial text ("Constructing…") is visual and replaced within the same region by the meaningful result.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic tables in an overflow wrapper with wrapping cell content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The enum matrix is a captioned semantic table inside .table-wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere cells; page-level overflow measured 0px at 360px.

summary: Strategy picker running one switch over the three enum values plus an unknown-value branch, fed by real constructions with and without requireUnreliable. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: honest fallback decision, real WebTransportError outcomes, clean console/network, 0px overflow on both classes.
